turbulence.description: When an enemy target with "Steadfast Safeguard" is inflicted with Weakness Break, dispels control states from all allies, action advances, and grants Aha an extra turn (this turn will count as 10 fixed Punchline points).\nIncreases Ultimate DMG dealt to all enemies by 25% and Elation DMG by 15%.

blessings.name: Magic Time
blessings.description: At the start of battle, when there are 1/2/3/4 Elation character(s) in the team, increases the Elation of all allies by 10%/20%/30%/60%.

blessings.name: Collapse on Sight
blessings.description: Increases all enemies' Break DMG taken by 10%. After Breaking an enemy's Weakness, increases all allies' SPD by 15% for 2 turn(s).

blessings.name: Moment of Opportunity
blessings.description: Increases Follow-Up ATK and Ultimate DMG dealt by all allies by 50%, and additionally increases by 50% against enemy targets in Weakness Broken state.

blessings.name: Comic Relief
blessings.description: After an ally target uses an attack that deals Elation DMG, inflicts Vulnerability on the target receiving Elation DMG, increasing the DMG they take by 15% for 2 turn(s). This effect can trigger up to 1 time per enemy target per attack.

blessings.name: Exploit Opening
blessings.description: After any ally target inflicts a debuff to an enemy target, increases their CRIT DMG by 75% for 2 turn(s).

blessings.name: Land of Fertility
blessings.description: Increases Skill and Ultimate DMG dealt by all allies by 30%, and additionally increases Skill and Ultimate DMG dealt by the 1st character in the lineup by 30%.

blessings.name: Unstoppable Force
blessings.description: DMG dealt by memosprites ignores 20% of the target's DEF.

blessings.name: Heroic Vanguard
blessings.description: After the character in position 1 in the team uses Ultimate, their Weakness Break Efficiency increases by 50% and increases CRIT DMG by 50%, lasting for 1 turn(s).

blessings.name: Unto Apotheosis
blessings.description: When ally targets consume Skill Points, increases their CRIT DMG by 6%, stacking up to 10 times.
